patch_description:
This constructor replaces the original fixed concentric-ring layout with a contact-graph inspired nonlinear packing search. It starts from several staggered, hexagonal-like row patterns, because such patterns use square area more efficiently than rings while still allowing boundary circles to become larger or smaller independently.

For every candidate, the algorithm optimizes all center coordinates and all radii simultaneously. The constraints directly encode square containment and pairwise non-overlap. Multiple asymmetric row templates are tried because the best 26-circle packing need not preserve reflection or rotational symmetry. A final conservative feasibility projection ensures that numerical optimizer tolerance can never produce overlapping circles or circles outside the unit square.
